text:
maria: FYI — following the GPU capacity postmortem we need a focused owners + timeline list for the remediation items. I pushed a draft plan here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345 :eyes:
aj: ack. can we split quota vs scheduler vs headroom?
maria: yes. proposed owners in the doc. Quick run: quota -> aj, scheduler tuning -> devin, headroom planning -> jia, monitoring/alerts -> samir. PTAL.
devin: taking scheduler tuning. plan: tune preemption thresholds, bump kube-scheduler backoff, and test autoscaler headroom settings. estimate 3 dev days + 1 small canary.
aj: quota owner here. action: audit current tenant quotas, set soft limits + backstop, add emergency manual override. ETA EOD Wed.
jia: headroom/forecasting. I'll add a 6-week headroom curve using last 6 months of usage + surge multiplier. Need raw usage CSV from infra. @samir can you hand off S3 path?
samir: handing off s3://redwood-gpu-metrics/usage/2025-q4/*.csv now. Ops-bot: tag INF-2345 with 'data-ready'.
ops-bot: INF-2345 updated: data_ready=true, files=18, size=3.2GB
maria: nice. also, recurring pattern note: outages usually midday Tue/Thu. Need recurring capture in alerts. @devin pls add alert for scheduler queue growth > 120s for 3m.
devin: adding alert. quick snippet to add to alerting rule: ```expr: sum(rate(scheduler_queue_length[1m])) by (node) > 120``` will test in staging.
jia: for headroom we'll model two scenarios: steady growth (15%/wk) and burst (x3 for 2h). I'll post results Mon.
aj: quota fix will include: (1) tighten shared-pool ratio, (2) set per-tenant burst tokens, (3) doc runbook for manual override. Draft PR by Thu.
maria: good. one more: owners should set measurable success criteria. e.g., reduce queue spike frequency by 80% in next 30d, maintain P95 latency < 120ms during bursts, and keep monthly cost delta < 10%.
samir: I'll own dashboard for metrics + weekly digest. setting up a grafana panel and scheduled message to #incidents every Mon 09:00.
devin: question: do we want autoscaler parameter changes on prod immediately after canary? recommend a 24h canary in a low-traffic region then rollout.
maria: yes that's the plan.
aj: creating tracker tasks now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2350 (quota), INF-2351 (scheduler), INF-2352 (headroom), INF-2353 (alerts/dashboards).
incident-bot: New issue INF-2350 created by aj.
maria: thanks. action items recap (quick):
- aj: quota audit + PR by Thu
- devin: scheduler tuning + alert + canary (3d)
- jia: headroom model Mon + runbook
- samir: dashboard + weekly digest
I'll check in Fri 15:00 for blockers. If anyone needs to shift timelines ping me.
devin: noted. moving to in-progress.
aj: on it :thumbsup:
